global_caption: The video contains 7 shots. Emotional tone remains primarily romantic and expansive.
shot1: Shot 1 fades in from black, using a long shot overhead perspective. Composition places the outer stage of the orbital space station in the lower center of the frame, with endless starfield filling the background. A curved light strip draws attention to the central male anthropomorphic panda singer. Deep depth of field preserves layering of stars and mechanical structures. The scene is a metal stage extending from the space station’s exterior, outlined with low-saturation purple-blue neon, with soft cool backlight defining fur contours. At the end of the note, his other hand raises toward the observation dome, clothing and small earrings near his ears gently drifting due to external microgravity. Camera slowly dives down from above and slightly shifts clockwise, creating an opening draw from cosmos into the stage.
shot2: Shot 2 hard cuts from previous shot into close-up of main stage, using a close-up eye-level angle. Foreground sweeps past glowing pillars for speed sense, focus on the female anthropomorphic panda singer’s face and microphone head, background blurred but retaining neon archway of main stage. Scene transitions to the inner main performance area after the outer stage retracts, lighting still dominated by cool purple neon and white-blue backlight from behind, with only slight soft fill light on cheeks.
shot3: Shot 3 transitions from previous shot via a light-strip wipe effect, using a medium shot eye-level slightly low angle. Scene shifts to the transparent bridge connecting main stage and observation area, maintaining overall low-saturation cool tones, backlight coming from bridge end, creating thin highlights along glass edges. Camera steadily advances along bridge track, tracking backward at same speed as singer, creating continuous sensation of being led into next space.
shot4: Shot 4 uses natural hard cut from previous shot, cutting inside the observation dome to a wide two-shot eye-level view. Dome curve envelops both singers, external starfield and distant Earth silhouette occupy upper background, frame symmetrically balanced with central space reserved for dual interaction, focus covering both performers and shared stage center. Scene logically continues from bridge endpoint, dome floor has circular glowing patterns, neon still subtly lit, backlight from dome edge outlining silhouettes. Camera first makes small half-circle orbit then stops at center, fully presenting both dome and performer positioning.
shot5: Shot 5 enters zero-gravity zone after brief fade from previous shot, using a medium close-up low-angle view. Scene located in zero-g performance area beside observation dome, primary lighting still purple-blue neon, backlight seeping through wall gaps, forming sharp edges on fur surface. In floating state, toes remain off ground, legs naturally tucked, mic and clothing corners sway slowly due to inertia, creating smooth zero-g motion. Camera performs counterclockwise orbiting follow, slightly slower than subject drift, emphasizing zero-gravity rotation.
shot6: Composition centers the same microphone slightly below center, both singers’ faces enter from left and right, foreground shows slightly defocused metallic mesh of mic stand, focus precisely on lips, eyes, and mic grille, background retains only softened neon lines. Scene remains at transition point from zero-g zone edge to airlock corridor, lighting continues unified cool tone with added soft fill, enhancing facial details at close range.
shot7: Shot 7 uses slow pull-out seamless transition from previous shot to final wide long shot. Camera angle slightly low and upward-looking, airlock frame acts as natural framing device, background features massive Earth’s curved glow and thin cloud reflection, foreground ground guide lights converge toward the two singers standing side-by-side at the door. Scene is the final stage at the space station airlock, overall maintaining low-saturation cyberpunk atmosphere, Earth’s reflection and airlock backlight jointly outline character silhouettes, neon only used as edge accent. Two anthropomorphic panda singers stand side-by-side, together raising microphones forward for synchronized closing At final note, both gently extend hands outward then retract to chest, transitioning from prior floating motions to stable stance, completing emotional consolidation of entire performance. Camera continuously pulls back and slightly tilts upward, fully incorporating airlock, figures, and Earth’s glow into frame, holding final frame with a sense of performance finale.
